settings.visualStyle: Immersive first-person WWII historical reenactment, Second Battle of El Alamein 1942, British Eighth Army infantry POV, moonlit desert, minefield lanes, dust, artillery flashes, early Sherman and British vehicles in distance, authentic desert uniforms, non-graphic combat, no modern objects, no game HUD.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds = 120 seconds. Fictional composite British Eighth Army infantry soldier POV during the Second Battle of El Alamein. One primary action and one camera movement per scene. No spoken dialogue, no narration and no intelligible human speech. Audio uses breathing, nonverbal exertion, desert wind, footsteps, equipment, engines and distant battlefield effects only.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person desert warfare reenactment, warm sand, cold moonlight, harsh daylight, dust and practical period equipment, restrained cinematic camera.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP03 — El Alamein: Through the Devil's Gardens
movie.storySummary: A fictional British Eighth Army infantry soldier advances through the minefields and artillery-lit desert during the Second Battle of El Alamein, ending as the Axis defensive line breaks and the Allied advance continues west.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Put the viewer in the eyes of a fictional composite British Eighth Army infantry soldier at El Alamein, 23 October–4 November 1942. Show the opening artillery barrage, marked lanes through dense minefields, infantry movement, dust, tank silhouettes, exhaustion and the eventual breakthrough. Tell everything visually. No spoken dialogue and no narrator. Human sound is limited to breathing and nonverbal exertion.

scenes.title: Before the Guns
scenes.description: POV waits in a desert trench before the offensive begins.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier checks his rifle and looks over the trench edge.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person British infantry POV in shallow desert trench at night, khaki sleeves, rifle, moonlit sand, artillery batteries behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow rise toward trench edge. Audio: desert wind, equipment rustle, distant engines, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: The Barrage
scenes.description: The opening artillery bombardment erupts across the horizon.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV flinches as the horizon lights with massed artillery fire.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view over desert as British artillery flashes stretch across horizon, dust rising, no close explosions on people.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static POV with one slow tilt across artillery flashes. Audio: sustained artillery barrage, deep rolling thunder, sand vibration, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Forward
scenes.description: The infantry climbs out and begins the night advance.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV climbs from the trench and follows silhouettes into the desert.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person British soldier stepping into moonlit desert behind dispersed infantry silhouettes, artillery flashes behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: One continuous forward climb and walk. Audio: boots on sand, barrage, gear movement, breathing. Soldiers use only hand signals. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Minefield Markers
scenes.description: Engineers mark a safe lane through the defensive minefields.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier enters a narrow taped lane through disturbed sand.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view of white tape markers forming a lane across dark desert minefield, engineer crouched beside route, squad moving single file.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow forward move between tape markers. Audio: distant barrage, boots, tape flutter, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: One Step at a Time
scenes.description: The squad advances carefully through the lane.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV places each boot inside the marked path.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person downward view of boots following taped minefield lane in sand, squadmate feet ahead, dim moonlight.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low walking POV focused on careful footsteps. Audio: sand crunch, fabric, distant guns, measured breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Dust and Fire
scenes.description: Shell bursts throw dust across the route ahead.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV drops low as dust rolls across the lane.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person crouched in desert minefield lane, dust cloud crossing ahead, silhouettes low to ground, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera drops once to low cover. Audio: distant shell burst, rushing dust, equipment clatter, sharp breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: First Light
scenes.description: Dawn reveals the scale of the battlefield.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier rises behind a low ridge and looks across the desert.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dawn view over El Alamein battlefield, smoke columns, infantry positions, tank silhouettes in distance, pale desert sky.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow upward tilt over ridge to wide battlefield. Audio: wind, distant guns, engines far away, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Tank Column
scenes.description: Allied tanks move through a cleared corridor behind the infantry.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV turns toward a tank column passing through dust.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view of historically plausible Allied tanks moving through cleared desert lane, dust trails, infantry crouched nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: One slow pan toward passing tanks. Audio: tank engines, tracks, wind, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Hold the Ridge
scenes.description: The unit holds a low ridge under sustained fire.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV settles behind a shallow scrape with rifle ready.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person rifle over low desert scrape, dust and smoke beyond, squadmates spread along ridge.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static low POV with one rifle settle action. Audio: wind, distant bursts, sand movement, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Water
scenes.description: A brief pause for water and ammunition.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier takes one quick drink from a canteen.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands lifting a metal canteen against bright desert light, dusty sleeves, rifle resting nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static close POV with one drink action. Audio: canteen cap, swallowing, wind, distant artillery, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Supercharge
scenes.description: Time shifts to the renewed push of Operation Supercharge.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV stands and joins infantry moving forward again.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person daylight desert advance with infantry line and tank silhouettes moving through churned ground, early November 1942.
scenes.videoPrompt: Single forward walking movement with advancing line. Audio: engines, artillery, boots, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Past the Defenses
scenes.description: The soldier moves through abandoned defensive positions.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV steps past empty sandbag positions and damaged equipment.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view moving through abandoned Axis trench line, sandbags and disabled equipment, no bodies shown, dust and sunlight.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow forward move through one abandoned position. Audio: wind, loose canvas, distant engines, footsteps, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: The Road West
scenes.description: Retreating traffic is visible far beyond the broken line.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV raises binoculars toward distant vehicles moving west.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person binocular view of distant desert road with vehicle columns withdrawing, heat haze and dust, no close combat.
scenes.videoPrompt: One binocular raise and hold. Audio: wind, distant engines, binocular handling, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Breakthrough
scenes.description: The unit advances beyond the former defensive belt.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV follows the squad across open desert beyond the defensive line.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person infantry movement across open desert with cleared minefield markers behind, vehicles advancing nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady forward movement west. Audio: boots, engines, wind, equipment movement, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: End of the Beginning
scenes.description: The episode ends with the column advancing into the desert after the breakthrough.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV walks beside the moving column under a wide desert sky.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view beside Allied column moving west across Egyptian desert, dust, late-afternoon sun, no triumphal staging.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow forward tracking beside column. Audio: engines, wind, boots, tired breathing. No speech, no narration.

characters.name: POV Soldier

characters.description: Anonymous first-person soldier with historically plausible 1942 British desert uniform and rifle; face generally not shown.
